basis: LF-only adaptation of the checked R2 original La Scala reference reconstruction
layout_reference: User photo s-l1600.jpg: LF bin with separate upper horn assembly resting above
coordinate_system: mm; X centered, Y=0 front, Y=622.3 rear. Original bin underside Z=0; removable cover Z=-19.05 to 0; closed deck top Z=603.25
changes: Removed upper cabinet, its top cap, upper motorboard and both upper horn references.
Shortened both outer sides to existing bass-shelf top.
Retained existing sealed LF top deck at its exact R2 position; no extra top sheet.
unchanged: All fourteen retained LF panels, including floor/access cover, motorboard, angled doghouse, rear wings, splitter and shelf/back, are geometrically identical to R2. Generic woofer envelope also retained.
crossover_scope: Passive crossover; exact original/upgrade selection awaits final driver/horn choice. DSP out of scope.
uncertainties: R2 doghouse roof blank / bevel interpretation remains unverified.
R2 true 30-degree wing faces retained, including 5.656687 mm air-face endpoint offset.
R2 bottom thickness and centered underlay placement retained; exact gasket and screw locations not verified.
Woofer remains a generic clearance envelope. Separate upper horn, its support feet, fasteners, wiring and crossover enclosure are not modeled.
No load capacity or stability rating for a particular horn/stand is implied. Mounting can be detailed once actual horn/stand dimensions are supplied.
Nominal 3/4-inch material is modeled as 19.05 mm.
